decisions.reason: The exact-output swap and ETH refund policy applies only to the ETH conversion path; direct USDC mint behavior remains unchanged.
The decision concerns ETH-to-USDC wallet conversion and does not change the deferred Transak fiat purchase flow.
Changing execution and refund behavior within the ETH path does not alter which payment currencies customers may select or how they are disclosed.
The exact-output swap targets the already-required 15 USDC mint amount and therefore changes settlement mechanics, not the existing $15 primary-mint price.
ETH swap execution and excess-refund currency do not change how fiat buyers access commissions, tickets, prizes, or dashboard information.
The source decision does not affect background wallet creation or custody behavior for Transak fiat buyers.
The accepted ETH swap and refund mechanics do not change the rule that success confirmation appears only after a genuine NFT mint.
The source changes how an available ETH payment is processed, not whether ETH, USDC, or Card is selectable.
The NFT ebook product type and unlimited-supply model remain unchanged by the ETH payment conversion policy.
Swapping ETH for exactly 15 USDC and refunding excess ETH does not alter the established allocation of the 15 USDC primary-sale proceeds.
The source decision does not mention or necessarily alter optional tipping, tip presets, or custom tips.
The source accepts an ETH settlement implementation choice but does not require any change to the approved FAQ content.
